### `users`

**Purpose:** Stores application user accounts and authentication credentials.

**Source:** `database/models.py` → `User` class

| Column | Type | Nullable | Default | Constraints | Description |
|--------|------|----------|---------|-------------|-------------|
| `id` | INTEGER | No | auto-increment | PRIMARY KEY | Unique user identifier |
| `email` | VARCHAR(255) | No | — | UNIQUE, NOT NULL | User email address (login) |
| `hashed_password` | VARCHAR(512) | No | — | NOT NULL | bcrypt-hashed password |
| `full_name` | VARCHAR(200) | Yes | NULL | — | Display name |
| `is_active` | BOOLEAN | No | TRUE | NOT NULL | Account enabled flag |
| `is_admin` | BOOLEAN | No | FALSE | NOT NULL | Administrative privilege flag |
| `created_at` | TIMESTAMP | No | NOW() | NOT NULL | Record creation timestamp |
| `updated_at` | TIMESTAMP | No | NOW() | NOT NULL | Last modification timestamp |

**Indexes:**
- `idx_users_email` UNIQUE on `(email)`
- `idx_users_created_at` on `(created_at DESC)`

### `items`

**Purpose:** Core application resource owned by a user.

| `user_id` | INTEGER | No | — | FOREIGN KEY (users.id), NOT NULL | Owning user |

- `idx_items_created_at` on `(created_at DESC)`

**Purpose:** Tracks active user authentication sessions.

## 6. Stored Procedures and Triggers

### Trigger: `update_updated_at`

Applied to all tables with an `updated_at` column.
Automatically sets `updated_at = NOW()` before any `UPDATE` operation.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
  NEW.updated_at = NOW();
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
```
